gate.title: Grow your tourism business with TravelMateVR
gate.text: Manage bookings, availability, prices, your storefront, 360° content and marketing in one place, and see how travellers find you.
gate.demoNote: The demo account manages Kijani Tented Camps, a fictional business with sample guests. Real partner accounts are created after your application is approved.
gate.noAccess: You're signed in as {{email}}, which doesn't have access to this portal.

common.errDates: The end date must be on or after the start date.

sample.label: Sample data

sample.guest: This is a fictional sample guest used to demonstrate the portal.

insight.reviews_one: {{count}} review has no reply yet. Replies build trust with future guests.
insight.reviews_other: {{count}} reviews have no reply yet. Replies build trust with future guests.

insight.lowConversion: “{{title}}” gets views but few bookings. Better photos, a 360° capture or a clearer description usually help.

insight.vr_other: {{count}} listings have no 360° capture yet. Request one to stand out.

overview.title: Karibu, {{name}}
overview.text: Today at {{partner}}: requests, arrivals and how your listings are doing.
overview.chartNote: Base price and extras of confirmed bookings, by the month they were made.
overview.allClear: All clear. Nothing needs your attention right now.
overview.noArrivals: No arrivals in the next 7 days.

bookings.text: Every reservation for your listings, from requests to completed stays.
bookings.search: Search by guest, email or booking ID
bookings.name: Name
bookings.valueNote: Value is the base price plus extras, after any offer, before commission. Taxes and the traveller service fee are shown in each booking.
bookings.declineWarn: The guest will be notified and refunded in full ({{amount}} paid so far).
bookings.confirmed: Booking {{id}} confirmed. The guest has been notified.
bookings.declined: Booking {{id}} declined. The guest has been notified.
bookings.privacy: Use guest details only to deliver this booking. Don't add guests to marketing lists without their consent.
bookings.taxNote: The guest also paid {{taxes}} VAT (which you remit) and a {{fee}} TravelMateVR service fee.

calendar.text: Availability, arrivals and closed dates for each listing.
calendar.blockHint: Click a day to close or reopen it. Hold Shift and click another day to change a whole range.

listings.text: Your services as travellers see them. Changes go live straight away.
listings.paused: Listing paused. It's hidden from travellers.
listings.liveNote: Paused listings are hidden from search and can't be booked. Existing bookings stay valid.

listing.text: Edit content, prices and availability. Saved changes go live straight away.
listing.pausedNote: This listing is paused and hidden from travellers.
listing.langHint: Write in each language you serve. Empty fields fall back to the English text shown as a placeholder.
listing.title: Title
listing.summaryHint: Shown on cards in search results.
listing.bookingModeHint: With “Request to book”, you confirm each booking in the portal before the guest pays.

unitsHint.stay: Number of rooms or tents you can sell each night.
unitsHint.person: Number of places available each day.
unitsHint.other: Number of vehicles, tables or slots each day.

listing.indicative: This listing shows indicative prices. Travellers send a request and you confirm the final rate.
listing.seasonalHint: Override the base price for specific dates, such as peak migration months.

newListing.text: Describe a new service. Our team reviews every new listing before it goes live, usually within two working days.
newListing.reviewNote: After review you can add photos, a 360° capture and availability. We may suggest edits to make the listing clearer.
newListing.errTitle: Add a title of at least 4 characters.
newListing.errSummary: Add a summary of at least 10 characters.
newListing.errDescription: Describe the service in at least 40 characters.

customers.text: Guests who booked with you, grouped by email address.
customers.emptyText: Guests appear here after their first booking.
customers.privacy: Guest data is shared with you to deliver bookings. Exports and marketing use require the guest's consent.

messages.text: Questions from travellers before and after they book.
messages.emptyText: When travellers message you from your storefront or a booking, the conversation appears here.
messages.safety: Keep payments on TravelMateVR. Never ask guests for card details or to pay outside the platform.

quick.thanks: Asante for your message! We'll get back to you with details shortly.
quick.availability: Good news: we have availability on your dates. You can book directly on our TravelMateVR page.
quick.details: Could you share your dates, number of guests and any special requests? Then we can confirm everything.

reviews.text: What guests say about your listings. A short, personal reply shows future guests you care.
reviews.replyHint: Your reply is public and appears under the review. Be polite, specific and never share guest details.
reviews.emptyText: Reviews appear after guests complete a booking.
reviews.policy: Only guests with a completed booking can review. You can't edit or remove reviews, but you can report a review that breaks our guidelines.

revenue.text: What you earn, when you're paid, and what's coming.
revenue.connectFirst: Connect a payout account in Settings to receive payouts.
revenue.byMonthNote: After commission, in the month the stay or activity takes place. The highlighted bar is this month.
revenue.taxNote: This year guests also paid {{taxes}} VAT, which you remit to the tax authority, and {{contributions}} in conservation and community contributions, passed on in full.

marketing.text: Offers, campaigns, featured placement and packages to reach more travellers.
marketing.promotionsText: Discounts applied automatically at checkout for the dates you choose.
marketing.name: Name
marketing.promoHint: The discount applies to the base price and extras for stays or activities on these dates, and shows as a separate line in the guest's price breakdown.
marketing.campaignsText: Promote listings on TravelMateVR. Our team reviews every campaign before it runs.
marketing.campaignNote: Campaigns are labelled as promoted wherever they appear. AI TravelMate never ranks paid listings above better matches without saying so.

cstatusText.in_review: Our team will reply within two working days.
cstatusText.scheduled: Approved; starts on the start date.

marketing.featuredText: Featured listings appear in a highlighted slot on destination and category pages, labelled “Featured”.

featuredStatus.requested: Request sent; we'll be in touch

marketing.featuredRequested: Request sent. Our partnerships team will contact you.
marketing.sponsoredSoon: Sponsored placement, destination campaigns with tourism boards and enterprise advertising are being prepared. Ask our team to join the pilot.
marketing.packagesText: Bundle two or more of your services at one price, such as stay + game drive. Packages are reviewed before they go live.

analytics.text: How travellers find, view and book your listings over the last 12 months.
analytics.sampleNote: Bookings, revenue, guest markets, party types, lead times and peak periods come from actual bookings. Views, search appearances and enquiries are sample data until tracking is connected.
analytics.whichSample: applies to views, search appearances and enquiries.
analytics.interestNote: How often your listings appeared in search, and how often travellers opened them.
analytics.byBookingDate: By the month the booking was made.
analytics.weekdays: Day of the week bookings are made
analytics.weekdaysNote: Useful for timing offers and replies.
analytics.demandNote: Interest index from traveller searches and views of each destination (sample).

vr.text: 360° captures help travellers trust what they book. Upload your own or ask our team to capture your place.
vr.has360Text: Travellers can explore this listing in full 360°, including in VR headsets.
vr.previewOnlyText: Travellers see a panning preview of a photo. A 360° capture usually increases bookings.
vr.fileHint: Equirectangular (2:1) file in the format chosen above; up to {{mb}} MB.
vr.captureHint: Our capture team covers northern and southern Tanzania. We'll confirm the date and any travel cost first.
vr.notesPh: Which spaces to capture, best time of day, access details…
vr.uploaded: Upload received. Our content team checks every image before publishing.
vr.captureRequested: Capture request sent. We'll confirm the date with you.
vr.g1: Shoot at eye level from the middle of the space, with the camera on a stand.
vr.g2: Soft morning or late-afternoon light works best; avoid harsh midday sun.
vr.g3: Tidy the space and ask staff and guests to step out of the shot.
vr.g4: Capture what guests care about: the room, the view, the deck, the vehicle.
vr.privacy: Don't upload images that show guests or staff without their consent. Faces and number plates are blurred before publishing.
vr.formatVideoHint: Recommended: travellers can look around while the scene moves. MP4, MOV or INSV files.
vr.formatPhotoHint: Best for rooms and still views. JPG, PNG, WebP or TIFF equirectangular files.

profile.text: Your storefront: how your business appears to travellers. You control the text, cover image and contact details.
profile.taglinePh: e.g. Small tented camps where the herds pass
profile.errWebsite: Enter a secure web address starting with https://
profile.verifiedNote: Verification badges, licences and sustainability labels are managed by TravelMateVR after checking your documents.

team.text: Give your staff their own sign-in, with only the access they need.
team.dup: This person is already on your team.
team.inviteNote: Invitations expire after 7 days. Each person signs in with their own account; never share passwords.
team.enforced: Permissions are enforced by TravelMateVR's servers, not only hidden in the interface.

settings.text: Plan, payouts, notifications and security for your business account.
settings.planNote: Plan pricing is agreed in your partner agreement. Switching plans in the demo changes nothing else.

starter.name: Starter
starter.text: List your services and take bookings. Commission only.

growth.name: Growth
growth.text: For established businesses that want more visibility and insight.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.text: For groups, chains and destination partners. Custom terms.

features.f7: Dedicated account manager and API access

settings.commissionNote: set in your partner agreement (sample value in the demo)
settings.payoutSecurity: Payout details go to our licensed payment partner, which verifies the account before the first payout. TravelMateVR keeps only the last four digits.
settings.autoReply: Send an automatic acknowledgement when a guest messages you
settings.s1: Every team member signs in with their own account. Turn on two-step verification for owners and finance.
settings.s2: All portal actions are logged, so you can see who confirmed, cancelled or changed what.
settings.s3: TravelMateVR staff will never ask for your password or payout details by phone, email or WhatsApp.
settings.payoutsClosed: Payouts are open to businesses operating in Tanzania. They start in your country as soon as TravelMateVR launches there.
settings.accountHolderHint: Exactly as registered with the bank, usually your business name.

landing.title: Bring travellers to your door
landing.lede: List your lodge, camp, safari, tour or restaurant on TravelMateVR. Show it in 360°, take bookings, and get paid, with tools built for African tourism businesses.

categoryBenefit.operator: Let travellers preview your actual routes, vehicles and camps in 360° before they book — fewer last-minute cancellations, more guests who already know exactly what they're getting.
categoryBenefit.lodge: Show every room, view and common area exactly as it is. Guests who've already explored your property in 360° book with confidence and arrive with the right expectations.
categoryBenefit.restaurant: Give diners a seat at your table before they arrive. Show your dining room, your view, your atmosphere — stand out to travellers comparing options nearby.
categoryBenefit.transport: Showcase your vehicles, routes and comfort level in 360° so travellers book the right transport the first time, with fewer disputes over unmet expectations.
categoryBenefit.community: Put your community-led experience in front of travellers worldwide, with a share of every booking going directly back to the people who built it.
categoryBenefit.events: List your events where travellers are already planning their dates in your destination — fill seats for festivals, tours and experiences with real advance bookings.
categoryBenefit.guide: Share your local knowledge before the trip even begins, and be the expert travellers already trust before they land.

storefront.d: A professional page for your business in five languages, with your story, services and reviews.

vr.d: Let travellers look around before they book. Upload your captures or book our capture team.

ai.d: Your listings appear in AI-planned trips when they match what travellers ask for.

bookings.d: Instant booking or requests, availability, seasonal rates and closed dates in one calendar.

payments.d: Cards and mobile money through our payment partner, with deposits and scheduled payouts.

insights.d: See where guests come from, when they book and what to improve.

s1.d: Tell us about your business and services. It takes about 10 minutes.

s2.d: We check your licence and registration and get to know your business.

s3.d: Set up your storefront, listings and payouts, and start taking bookings.

landing.plansText: Start with commission only and grow when you're ready.
landing.pricingNote: Commission and plan prices are agreed individually during onboarding.
landing.ctaText: Apply today, or message our partnerships team on WhatsApp.
landing.whatsapp: Hello TravelMateVR, I'd like to list my tourism business.
landing.globalText: TravelMateVR has opened its first destinations in Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Europe. Launch partners there get featured placement while the marketplace grows.
landing.globalCreators: Film your tours in 360° with the creator programme

join.title: List your business
join.text: Tell us about your business. We review every application and reply within five working days.
join.aboutPh: What makes your business special? Who works with you? How long have you been operating?
join.errAbout: Tell us a little more (at least 40 characters).
join.community: The business is community-owned or majority locally owned
join.licenceHint: For example, your TALA licence in Tanzania. We verify it with the issuing authority.
join.certDocsHint: A copy of your tourism licence, business registration, or equivalent certification (PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10MB each). Required — applications without one can't be submitted.
join.errCertDocs: Attach at least one certification or licence document.
join.submitFailed: Something went wrong submitting your application. Please try again.
join.docsNote: Upload a copy of your licence or registration above. We verify it with the issuing authority before approving your application.
join.signInRequiredText: Create an account or sign in first — we tie every application to your account so we can keep you updated and verify your documents securely.
join.consent: I confirm the information is correct and agree to TravelMateVR's partner terms and privacy policy.
join.doneText: Your application ID is {{id}}. We've sent a confirmation to {{email}}.
join.closedText: We aren’t taking new partner applications at the moment. Please check back soon or message our partnerships team on WhatsApp.
join.previewCountry: Booking and payment on TravelMateVR are open in Tanzania for now. Apply today and get your storefront and 360° content ready: you'll start taking bookings and receiving payouts as soon as we launch in your country.
